
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/silent2012/p/23576728" title="发布于 2026-11-06 17:36">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">龙芯3B6000M运行Yolov8+FastApi</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>龙芯近日发布支持自研通用GPU的龙芯加速计算平台（Loongson Accelerated Computing Platform）首个软件版本，该平台基于龙芯2K3000（3B6000M) 及9A1000内集成的自研LG200系列通用GPU核心打造，实现了对算力芯片驱动、算力编程环境、AI模型推理等功能的全栈一体支持。兼容 OpenCL 3.0 规范、CUDA 5.0 计算能力规范及 CUDA API 10.0 规范，大幅降低国产算力生态门槛，并服务于工业视觉、智能安防等广泛领域。</p>
<p>请参考文档：<a href="https://docs.loongnix.cn/loongacm/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://docs.loongnix.cn/loongacm/</a></p>
<p>Yolov8是非常成熟和使用广泛的视觉检测模型，可用于目标检测、图像分类和实例分割等任务。手头有一款3B6000M龙芯派，本文抛砖引玉，基于龙芯3B6000M搭建了一个YoloV8+FastApi的Demo，可流畅运行，将搭建步骤分享一下：</p>
<p><strong>1、硬件准备</strong><br>  　　CPU：2K3000或3B6000M（<span>&nbsp;7.2 TOPS @ INT8<span>&nbsp;</span></span>）<br>  　　内存空间：至少 8GB RAM<br>  　　显存要求：大于等于 2GB<br>  　　操作系统：Loongnix25.2</p>
<p><strong>2、驱动安装</strong></p>
<p><strong>　　2.1 gpu驱动：</strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">wget https://repos.loongson.cn/loonggpu/loongnix25/local_installers/loonggpu-repo-loongnix25-local_1.0.2-lnd25.1_loong64.deb
sudo dpkg -i loonggpu-repo-loongnix25-local_1.0.2-lnd25.1_loong64.deb
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get -y install loonggpu-drive
</pre>
</div>
<p>　　安装后可以在终端验证一下，正常会出现如下结果：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">$ lspci -s 00:06.0 -vvv
00:06.0 Multimedia video controller: Loongson Technology LLC Device 7a35 (rev 10)
Control: I/O+ Mem+ BusMaster+ SpecCycle- MemWINV- VGASnoop+ ParErr- Stepping- SERR- FastB2B- DisINTx-
Status: Cap- 66MHz- UDF- FastB2B- ParErr- DEVSEL=fast &gt;TAbort- &lt;TAbort- &lt;MAbort- &gt;SERR- &lt;PERR- INTx-

</pre>
</div>

<p><strong> 　　3.2. INT8量化：</strong></p>

<div class="cnblogs_code">

</span>--action infer</pre>
</div>
<p><strong>4.部署运行FastApi</strong></p>
<p>　　建立python虚拟环境，然后部署fastapi：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>sudo apt install python3.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">13</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">venv
python3 </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">m venv venv
sudo chown </span>-R $USER:$USER /opt/lsai/demo/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">venv
source venv</span>/bin/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">activate

pip install fastapi uvicorn
#pip install opencv</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">python
pip install opencv</span>-contrib-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">python numpy
pip install python</span>-multipart</pre>
</div>
<p>　　新建app.py文件，定义几个简单访问接口（我这里只创建了上传和访问、下载接口），代码如下：</p>

@app.on_event(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">startup</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

def _read_upload_image(file: UploadFile) </span>-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> np.ndarray:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> not file.content_type.startswith(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">image/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
        raise HTTPException(status_code</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">400</span>, detail=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">请上传图片文件</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> img <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">400</span>, detail=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">无法解码图片</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> img

def _detect_and_draw(img: np.ndarray):
    boxes, scores, class_ids </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> detector.detect(img)

        detector.draw_detections(dst, boxes, scores, class_ids)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dst, boxes, scores, class_ids

@app.post(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/detect</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
def detect_objects(file: UploadFile </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> File(...)):
    img </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _read_upload_image(file)<br>　　_, boxes, scores, class_ids </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _detect_and_draw(img)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> boxes <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">detections</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: []}

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> box, score, cl <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> zip(boxes, scores, class_ids):

            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">bbox</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: [<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span>(x) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> x <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> box],
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">score</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(score),
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">class_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(cl),
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">class_name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: detector.classNames[<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>(cl)] <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>(cl) &lt; len(detector.classNames) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> str(cl)
        })
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> JSONResponse(content={<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">detections</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: results})

@app.post(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/detect/download</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
def detect_and_download(file: UploadFile </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> File(...)):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">检测并在响应中直接返回标注后的图片，触发浏览器下载。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    img </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _read_upload_image(file)
    dst, boxes, _, _ </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _detect_and_draw(img)

    # 编码为 JPEG 字节流（在内存中完成，不落盘）
    ok, buf </span>= cv2.imencode(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.jpg</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, dst, [<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>(cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY), <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">95</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">])
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> not ok:
        raise HTTPException(status_code</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">500</span>, detail=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">结果图编码失败</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

    # 生成下载文件名：基于上传文件名
    original_name </span>= file.filename or <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">upload</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    stem </span>= original_name.rsplit(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>)[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
    download_name </span>= f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{stem}_detected.jpg</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

    headers </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        # 关键：attachment 触发下载，filename 指定保存名
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Content-Disposition</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">attachment; filename="{download_name}"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> Response(content=buf.tobytes(), media_type=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">image/jpeg</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, headers=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">headers)

@app.post(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/detect/view</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
def detect_and_view(file: UploadFile </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> File(...)):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">检测并直接返回图片字节流，浏览器会内联显示（不下载）。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    img </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _read_upload_image(file)
    dst, _, _, _ </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _detect_and_draw(img)

    ok, buf </span>= cv2.imencode(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.jpg</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, dst)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> not ok:
        raise HTTPException(status_code</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">500</span>, detail=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">结果图编码失败</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> Response(content=buf.tobytes(), media_type=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">image/jpeg</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

@app.</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/health</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
def health():
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">status</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ok</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">model_loaded</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: detector <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> not None}(</pre>
</div>
<p>　　部署完成后通过以下命令进行启动：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>python3 -m uvicorn app:app --host <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.0</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.0</span> --port <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8000</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

#如果出现报错 ModuleNotFoundError: No module named </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">lacinfer</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
需要找到 lacinfer 实际所在的 site</span>-packages 或 dist-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">packages 目录，然后把它加到虚拟环境的搜索路径里，本代码执行：
echo </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/opt/lacm-0.1.0/lib</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> &gt; /opt/lsai/demo/venv/lib/python3.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">13</span>/site-packages/lacinfer_path.pth</pre>
</div>
